item_name: Rothco Reusable 3 Layer Facemask With Security Print
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Reusable 3-Layer Polyester Security Facemask is crafted for comfort and durability, making it ideal for public safety professionals. Featuring a 3-layer construction, this mask molds comfortably to the shape of your face for extended wear. The bold "Security" print on the front ensures clear identification. An adjustable nose bridge provides a secure fit, while soft fabric ear straps offer all-day comfort. Measuring 7 inch x 5 inch with 2 available sizes, the mask fits most wearers.
